principalStatement: Accept, push and proceed to the next step.
scope: Implement transactional MongoDB persistence and reload of the existing release-plan projection.
Enforce one release plan per story lifecycle through the contract semantic key.
Apply the released release-plan event transition rules exactly and fail closed on stale or invalid writes.
Qualify restart recovery, exact event replay, duplicate races, transition conflicts, and organizational-acceptance lookup prerequisites.
excluded: Contract package mutation or a new contract revision.
Network Git provider calls or external repository mutation from MongoDB qualification tests.
Production deployment, historical migration, OpenHands integration, or SMA integration.
releaseRule: Freeze and report the Step 12 candidate locally; do not push it without subsequent principal acceptance.
